import { GiftIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/dialog" import { ScrollArea } from "@workspace/ui/components/scroll-area" const releases = [ { version: "2.8.0", date: "Nov 12", tag: "New", title: "Shared views", body: "Save filters and share them with your whole workspace.", }, { version: "2.7.3", date: "Nov 4", tag: "Improved", title: "Faster search", body: "Results now appear 3× faster on large workspaces.", }, { version: "2.7.1", date: "Oct 28", tag: "Fixed", title: "Timezone offsets", body: "Due dates no longer shift for teams east of UTC.", }, { version: "2.7.0", date: "Oct 20", tag: "New", title: "Recurring tasks", body: "Repeat tasks daily, weekly or on custom schedules.", }, ] export default function ChangelogDialog() { return ( }> What's new 4 What's new in Trellis Updates from the last 30 days.
    {releases.map((release) => (
  1. {release.tag} v{release.version} · {release.date}
